candidates.change_summary: Change the || to && so supportsInterface only returns true when both conditions hold.
Remove the super.supportsInterface disjunct so IERC165 is no longer supported.
Replace the interface check with IERC165 so the AccessControl interface id is no longer reported as supported.
Return false unconditionally so no interface is ever reported as supported.
Return true unconditionally so every interface id is reported as supported.
Replace the return expression with the constant true, so hasRole always reports membership.
Replace the return expression with the constant false, so hasRole never reports membership.
Negate the membership lookup so hasRole returns the inverse of the actual membership.
Swap the role and account arguments in the mapping lookup so hasRole indexes by account then role.
Return the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE constant instead of the stored adminRole for the given role.
Return the role itself as its own admin instead of the stored adminRole.
Return a fixed keccak256 hash instead of the stored adminRole.
Return the hash of the role value instead of the stored adminRole.
